abstract: Maintains labor engagement metrics, staff survey results, and workplace grievance records
system_message:
You are the Crew labor relations lead (LABR). Your responsibilities include maintaining labor engagement metrics, staff survey results, and workplace grievance records across regional emergency airlift staffing rosters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Workplace grievance case resolution（GRIEV）
information_points.content:
LABR-GRIEV-H0O：Labor relation committee records over the past calendar year document an average grievance settlement timeframe of 20 d to resolve informal grievance consultations for the Flight physician and critical care paramedic pair.
LABR-GRIEV-UDT：Labor relation committee casework logs covering workplace mediation filings over the past calendar year show an average grievance settlement timeframe of 30 d to resolve informal grievance consultations for the Dual-flight-nurse intensive care crew.
LABR-GRIEV-11S：Workplace mediation filings over the past calendar year show that the Advanced practice paramedic and respiratory specialist team maintains an average grievance settlement timeframe of 10 d for informal casework resolutions.

information_points.title: Maintains labor engagement metrics, staff survey results, and workplace grievance records（UNON）
information_points.content:
LABR-UNON-N32：Quarterly survey feedback across active flight and clinical personnel indicates that the Dual-flight-nurse intensive care crew achieved a crew roster preference satisfaction rating of 76% for shift bidding and rotation stability.
LABR-UNON-I3I：Based on quarterly crew survey feedback covering active flight and clinical staff, the Flight physician and critical care paramedic pair holds a crew roster preference satisfaction rating of 64% regarding shift bidding and rotation stability.
LABR-UNON-QA2：According to quarterly feedback from active flight and clinical personnel, the Advanced practice paramedic and respiratory specialist team recorded a crew roster preference satisfaction rating of 88% regarding shift bidding and rotation stability.
